scripts.dev: pnpm --filter bonkei build && pnpm --parallel --filter bonkei --filter "./apps/*" dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter bonkei build && pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm --filter "./apps/*" build && node scripts/build-docs.mjs && node scripts/assemble-pages.mjs && node scripts/check-pages.mjs
scripts.size: pnpm --filter bonkei build && pnpm --filter bonkei size
scripts.check:package: pnpm --filter bonkei build && pnpm --filter bonkei check
scripts.docs:dev: node scripts/docs-install.mjs && npm --prefix docs run dev
scripts.smoke: node scripts/smoke/vite.mjs && node scripts/smoke/script-tag.mjs && node scripts/smoke/embeds.mjs && node scripts/smoke/docs-run.mjs
